verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents API endpoints for submitting orders and retrieving a fraud decision, but contains no mention of configurable score-range-to-action mapping, ops-tunable thresholds, or step-up 3DS orchestration. Missing for 10: any documentation of a rules/policy engine for mapping scores to allow/review/block/3DS actions, threshold configuration UI or API, and evidence of ops-level risk appetite tuning.
